thread:
Asha (Partnerships): Quick sync - were launching the CloudMarket listing + partner announcement next week. Need a lightweight concierge lane for partner support + clear SEV routing. Proposal: one channel, explicit P0/P1 definitions, a 10m SLACK ack, and a short war-room cadence. Thoughts?

Diego (Partner Eng): Sounds good. Can we standardize labels: `p0` (platform down for partner), `p1` (blocking for partner functionality), `nonsev` (questions)? That'll help automate routing.

Nina (Marketplace): I like single channel: #marketplace-launch-concierge. Marketplace team should be second-tier (after partner-eng) unless listing infra is broken. Also we should include a short template for partners to post: product, env, steps to reproduce, impact.

Kai (SRE): For SRE involvement we want an objective threshold before paging: i) service 50%+ error rate for partner traffic or ii) production listing jobs failing end-to-end. Otherwise SRE watches the channel and will only be paged for `p0` with `escalate:sre`. Ack SLA: 5m for p0, 15m for p1.

Maya (Customer Success): We'll pre-populate the channel with SI and HW integrator slack handles and a short onboarding note: who to ping, and who to cc for legal/billing. Also recommend a 15m check-in for first 72h (lighter cadence than a full war-room).

Asha (Partnerships): Nice. Can someone draft the pinned checklist? Keep it minimal so partners actually follow it.

Diego (Partner Eng): Pinned checklist draft: 

```
1) Tag message with `p0`/`p1`/`nonsev` and include `env:` (prod/staging)
2) Paste short reproduction steps + attach logs/screenshots
3) Assign triage owner: @PartnerEng
4) If `p0`, add `escalate:sre` and call a quick sync
5) Include partner contact + SI/vendor slack handles
6) Postmortem: owner creates summary in #postmortems within 3 business days
```

Nina (Marketplace): Recommend we have PartnerOpsBot auto-ack and template-fill. Can it attach a runbook link and stub a Jira ticket if `p0`?

PartnerOpsBot: yes. I will: auto-ack with a short template, tag using keyword heuristics, and create a stub incident when messages include `p0` or `escalate:sre`. Config example: `auto_ack:true`, `create_incident_on:['p0']`, `tag_keywords:{'infra':['timeout','500','down'],'billing':['invoice','billing'],'product':['ui','api']}`.

Kai (SRE): Operational note: any incident created must include `partner:marketplace-launch` label so runbooks and alerts filter properly. Also add `runbook:marketplace` to incident template.

Maya (Customer Success): For hardware partners: prefix their handles with `vendor:` and include serials/firmware in the initial post. SI partners: prefix `si:` so we can route faster.

Asha (Partnerships): Rotation proposal: Diego (day), Nina (eve), Maya (overnight). Each rotation is 6 hours during launch window. We'll publish calendar invites and escalation matrix.

Diego (Partner Eng): Agree. Also let's define expected timelines in the pinned doc: ack -> 10m, triage update -> 30m, mitigation plan -> 2h for P0. P1 timelines can be more relaxed but still have a 4h mitigation target.

Nina (Marketplace): For public-facing announcement we need a comms lead on the channel to approve any external messages about outages. Suggest @Asha takes that during launch.

Asha (Partnerships): I'll be comms lead. Add note: no external statements without comms sign-off; internal workaround notes OK.

PartnerOpsBot: Channel #marketplace-launch-concierge created. Pinned checklist posted. Rotation invites sent to: Diego, Nina, Maya. Incident stubs will include labels: `partner:marketplace-launch`, `runbook:marketplace`. Template link: https://templates.redwood.com/partner-concierge-template

Kai (SRE): I'll run a 10m pre-launch oncall walkthrough tonight to review paging thresholds and incident creation steps.

Maya (Customer Success): I'll seed the channel with partner handles and a short "how to report" message and tag SI/HW vendors now.

Asha (Partnerships): Great. Keep it lightweight, try this for the first 72h, then we'll capture lessons and update the runbook. :white_check_mark:
